t: This is Demon with Bowl, a sculpture by Damien Hirst. Hirst is an English artist and art collector, and was one of the Young British Artists who dominated the UK art scene in the 1990s. During that decade his career was closely linked with the collector Charles Saatchi, though their relationship ended in 2003. He is reportedly the richest living artist in the United Kingdom. Take a moment to walk around the figure and see it from each side.
